```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

# **DECISION POINT: Gapfilling missing StockStatus_final values**
Missing stock status values were imputed using the mean stock status of available observations within the same region, year, and Major Functional Group. This stratified mean-imputation approach accounts for spatial, temporal, and functional-group differences in stock status. This approach assumes that the available stock status observations are reasonably representative of the missing observations within that region, year, and functional group.

```{r Gap-fill stock status details between years}
colnames(AFO_df)

AFO_df_gapfilled <- AFO_df %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  mutate(
    regional_StockStatus = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
   
    StockStatus_missing = is.na(StockStatus_final),
    
    StockStatus_final = coalesce(StockStatus_final, regional_StockStatus),
    StockStatus_source = if_else(
      StockStatus_missing,
      "Gapfill: mean stock status in that region that year",
      StockStatus_source
    ),
    StockStatus_est.level = if_else(
      StockStatus_missing,
      "region level",
      StockStatus_est.level
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-regional_StockStatus, -StockStatus_missing)
# 4691 obs., 8 vars.

```

# **DECISION POINT: Do not exclude values missing a genus**
```{r How much of the biomass is unassigned at the genus level?}
table(AFO_df$estimated_genus_name)

unassigned <- AFO_df_gapfilled %>%
  mutate(is_no_genus = estimated_genus_name == "no_genus") %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_landings_mt_sum = sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),

    no_genus_landings_mt = sum(
      total_landings_mt[is_no_genus],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    pct_no_genus = 100 * no_genus_landings_mt / total_landings_mt_sum,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# About 55% of landings in Region_6 are unassigned at the genus level in 2018...

```


# STEP 5: Calculate AFO Scores ------------------------------
Calculate scores per region!!
Here, the AFO score represents the landings-weighted average stock status for a given region and year.

```{r Calculate AFO_Scores}
colnames(AFO_df_gapfilled)

# Use this chunk of code if you **DO** want to use the gap-filled data:
AFO_Scores0 <- AFO_df_gapfilled %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    AFO_landings_mt = round(sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_StockStatus = round(mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    AFO_score = round(100 * sum(StockStatus_final * total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# 80 obs., 5 vars.

# Use this chunk of code if you **DO NOT** want to use the gap-filled data:
# AFO_Scores0 <- AFO_df %>%
#   group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id) %>%

#                     sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
#     .groups = "drop"
#   )
# 80 obs., 5 vars.

```

```{r Summarize what they are catching in Region 7 and 8}
Region_summary<- GOC_MarineFisheryLandings %>%
  select(year, OHI_rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group, weight_kg_corrected) %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  summarize(
    total_weight_mt= sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    n_records= n()
  )

Region78_summary<- GOC_MarineFisheryLandings %>%
  filter(OHI_rgn_id %in% c("Region_7", "Region_8")) %>%
  select(year, OHI_rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group, weight_kg_corrected) %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  summarize(
    total_weight_mt= sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    n_records= n()
  )

# Remove anything less than 2 metric tons:

Region78_summary<- Region78_summary %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVAL_PERIOD & year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  filter(max(total_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE) >= 5) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r Plot what they are catching in Region 7 and 8}
unique(Region78_summary$Major_Functional_Group)

# Colors for these 13 groups:
mfg_cols <- qualitative_hcl(
  17,
  palette = "Dark 3"
)

# Pelagics<- c("Anchovy & Sardine (small pelagics)", 
#              "Pelagic marine fish (excl. anchovy & sardine)")


Region78_plot<- Region78_summary %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVAL_PERIOD & year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = total_weight_mt, group= OHI_rgn_id)) +
  
    geom_col(
    aes(color= OHI_rgn_id, fill= OHI_rgn_id), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Colors (most useful when grouping by Major_Functional_Group)
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mfg_cols) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = mfg_cols) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Annual Catch (metric tons)",
    title = "Catch by Major_Functional_Group (Regions 7 and 8)"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Major_Functional_Group) +
  
  # Minimal theme and sleek styling
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey30")
  )

Region78_plot
```
